dialogue_texts: The scent of incense, aging parchment, and unraveling logic...
It's become like an eccentric theater troupe, repeating the same stage cue over and over.
I will overwrite the history of Kozankyo as vengeance for the Scarlet Devil!
An ink blot distorting the script? Oh, how delightful!
Having learned that you've taken out the Grieg twins, the fabric of this parallel tale will tear under its own weight!
Many have tried to capture eternity - painters, poets, and emperors with their brushstrokes.
Prepare for me to force-close your chapter!
